description: List the TRX ledger of the logged-in user's internal account (deposits, order payments, refunds), newest first, with the current balance and deposit address. Amounts are SUN strings. Use to reconcile spending after orders. For the orders themselves use `tronsave_internal_order_history` (API key) or `tronsave_list_orders` (`isOnlyMyOrder`); for the balance alone, `tronsave_get_internal_account`. Page with `offset`/`limit`. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only.

offset.description: Number of ledger entries to skip for pagination (default 0); add `limit` to page forward.

name: tronsave_list_internal_transactions
title: Internal Account Transactions
